entries.ja_full: グレッグ・ベア・イーガン
entries.role: Iconoclastic Tresor scientist studying the Scub Coral; Mischa's ex-husband
entries.personality: Iconoclastic out-of-the-box thinker; affectionate toward Mischa
variants: Greg Bear Egan (akurasu; Wikipedia bold name; literal match for the Japanese full label)
entries.notes: Main wiki page title is 'Greg Egan' ('Dr. Bear' redirects to it), chosen per instructions. However the game's full label グレッグ・ベア・イーガン includes ベア, so 'Greg Bear Egan' (akurasu/Wikipedia) is the closer match for that label -- project should decide. Short label ベア = 'Bear'; he is normally addressed as 'Dr. Bear' (nicknamed for his huge body, per Wikipedia). 'Gregory' was not found in any opened source. Gender Male.
